profile.summary: Software Engineer Working on a Critical Wall Street Foreign Exchange Application

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer working on a Wall Street Application that handles Foreign Exchange Deals Processing.
Implemented multiple AWS Lambda functions (Java and Python), ECS batch services (Maven/Java), and Spring Based microservices.
Developed a very strong level of AWS knowledge handling rehydrations, deployments, and general cloud management. 
Worked on developing critical solutions to handle Trade/Payment Requests and process trade data using in house Java Spring applications and APIs.
Handled the onboarding of large data sets onto the cloud via SQL and AWS Data Lake

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer working on a Google-based SRE monitoring system, using Angular (frontend), GoLang (backend), and Docker/Kubernetes.
Implemented SSO authentication for the application using Go middleware
Created several API services to handle data using Go/Gin and implement a PagerDuty based Webhook for SRE alerts for customers.
Revamped several portions of the Webpage to handle and visualize data.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed a full-stack web application utilizing Angular (Front-end), Java/Spring Boot (Back-end), PostgreSQL and  AWS (Database). Substantially shortens production timeline and makes Beta testing easier by allowing business owners to target specific groups of users to deploy features to and receive feedback from.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Spring Boot · SQL · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: GBTS Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Utilized scripting via PowerShell and AWS to automate server processes within Prudential’s Infrastructure. Network configurations were automated to improve migration/patch speeds.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Provide technical assistance with computer usage, software, device connections, and OS to students and employees at the Rutgers Business School located on Livingston Campus.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Utilized C and Matlab to improve the performance of MIT based lensless camera software and created an image by processing deflections of light. Developed an object-detection utility using Python and Tensorflow to detect gait and collision  in users at a nursing home in Singapore

projects.title: Cosmic Crusaders
projects.description: Designed, programmed, and graphically developed game using Java. (A two player PVP infinite vertical scroller set in the solar system)

projects.title: Student Space Flight Experiment Program Muscle Regeneration in Microgravity
projects.description: In association with Liberty Science Center and NASA, and SpaceX Created an experiment pertaining to the regeneration of subscapularis muscle tissue in space. The experiment was queued to go to the International Space Station to be conducted and sent in February 2017.
